name: Prestige - Company Profile
body:
> Profile · Prestige · 2026-08-12

The folder has no formal Business Knowledge Base, and the blog cluster docs keep asking for one. This profile pulls together what the audits and the captured live-site data say.

# Business
- Legal name: Prestige Plumbing Repairs LLC. Brand: Prestige Plumbing.
- Owner-operated by Matt Milunec ("the plumber who answers the phone"). Matt is the author on all blog posts (Person schema, author URL /about/).
- Base: Bluffton, SC (SC Lowcountry). Coverage runs about 50 miles from Bluffton with the same pricebook everywhere and no distance or island surcharge (per the hub draft and the llms.txt description in the June audit).
- NAP (consistent site-wide): Prestige Plumbing, (843) 800-4676, 147 Buggy Drive, Bluffton, SC 29909.
- Service areas (6 city pages): Bluffton, Hilton Head Island, Okatie, Sun City Hilton Head, Hardeeville, Ridgeland.
- Residential plumbing. The careers page says it hires licensed plumbers and apprentices as it grows.

# Services and published flat-rate prices (from site meta and audits)
- Water heaters from $1,895 (Bradford White), $1,895 to $2,307 installed.
- Tankless from $4,909 (Navien), Rinnai $5,075.
- Drain cleaning $255 to $425 per line (main line with camera $425), hydro jetting $950.
- Leak detection $289, leak and water line repair from $330, PRV $575, underground repair $825.
- Toilets: running toilet fix from $225, new toilets from $550, comfort-height $605.
- Water filtration from $1,565 (the Okatie page meta says from $1,095), Halo whole-house $4,200, softener $3,169, reverse osmosis $1,975, water test $125.
- Emergency: owner answers 24/7, weekend and after-hours dispatch $125.
- Ridgeland: well systems (pressure switches $369, well tanks).
- Brands named in llms.txt: Bradford White, Navien, Rinnai, Halo.

# Positioning
- Flat-rate, quoted before work, same-day in most cases, owner answers the phone.
- Local angles used in content: vacation rentals and villas on Hilton Head, the Sun City 55+ community, Ridgeland wells, live oak roots, slab foundations, hurricane season.

# Content guardrails (from the blog drafts)
- Pricing, "free estimate/inspection", warranty or guarantee wording and emergency rate language are held for Scott and kept out of blog bodies.
- No invented first-hand proof. `[FIRST-HAND DETAIL]` placeholders wait for Matt's real photos or notes.
